assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period.
The diagnosis codes I49.9, I48.91, and R55 support the medical necessity of this service.
The denial code CO-197 indicates that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
